description: 109年高雄市政府所屬機關iTaiwan無線網路統計資料 [telecommunications] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 高雄市政府研究發展考核委員會. 109年-高雄市政府所屬機關iTaiwan無線網路統計資料. Coverage: 高雄市政府研究發展考核委員會. The portal lists 10 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 高雄市政府研究發展考核委員會. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
